title: Late-Charge Clock Start for Installed Window Contracts
content:
# Late-Charge Clock Start for Installed Window Contracts

Window Replacement Contracts — clock rule for late balance charges, reading Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing and Installation Jobs records.

**Rule.** The late-charge clock starts on the installation completion date, except as follows: for a contract paid by Ridgeline financing whose lender funding posted after the installation completion date, the clock starts on the lender funding date; for any other contract whose installation job closed after the installation completion date, the clock starts on the date the installation job closed.

The late-charge start date is reckoned from the clock start by adding the series final-balance due days, in calendar days; full 30-day periods are counted from that start date to the day the charge is figured.

**Records read.** The lender funding date is the funded date of the contract's Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account in force (approved, active, delinquent or paid off); the installation job is the contract's installation job that is not cancelled. A cancelled or charged-off financing account, or a cancelled installation job, is never read; where there is no such record, there is no lender funding date and no installation job closing date.

| Contract | Lender funding after completion | Job closed after completion | Clock starts on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid by Ridgeline financing | Yes | Either | The lender funding date |
| Paid by Ridgeline financing | No | Yes | The installation job's closing date |
| Paid by cash, check or card | — | Yes | The installation job's closing date |
| Any | No | No | The installation completion date |

## Hypothetical cases (installation completed 2031-07-14)

- Financed contract, funding posted 2031-07-25, job closed 2031-07-30: clock starts 2031-07-25.
- Financed contract, funding posted 2031-07-10, job closed 2031-07-30: funding was not after completion, so the clock starts 2031-07-30.
- Card-paid contract, job closed the same day as completion: clock starts 2031-07-14.
